method.spill: an overflow's monitor events joined when they overlap or start less than 1 hour after the last ended

attribution: Environment Agency, storm overflow EDM start/stop data 2024 and 2025, Open Government Licence v3.0

claim.public_wording: How long this overflow's spills lasted in 2024 and 2025, from the water company's monitor records published by the Environment Agency. A record of the past, not a forecast. It says nothing of how much was discharged.
not_claimed: a forecast of when a spill will end
the volume or strength of a discharge
that a short spill was harmless
that companies record events the same way
